summary: Tempest Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing a September 11 securities purchase agreement for a private placement with one institutional investor. The company issued pre-funded warrants for 3,105,591 shares plus Series C and D common warrants each for 3,105,591 shares, at a combined $0.804 per pre-funded warrant and accompanying common warrants. Gross proceeds total about $2.5 million, with up to $5 million more if common warrants are exercised; common warrant exercise price is $0.805. Closing occurred September 15. This is a routine unregistered equity financing, not a special situation, though stockholder approval within 90 days is needed for common warrant exercise and represents a dilutive overhang to monitor.
